page.notes: Long s read as plain s throughout. Initial I in Ioannes, Iacobus, Iesuitarum changed to J as consonant. Final j in Pontificij read as i. The ff in affumptam, affirmare and asseruisse is read as ss where the scan shows a long-s pair; affirmare may be a real f. Italic spans are judged from the scan and may be slightly off at the edges; book titles (Ecclesiasticis, Disputatione Euangelica) were set roman. Printer's line-filling dashes at line ends (after mysterium, Maria, Idolorum esse) omitted. Last line "rum," is the second half of misericordiarum, indented on the scan.
